description: Land Acquisition - Ranwediyawa, Bambawa, Aluthwewa, Dambagolla, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land lots, their locations, types (paddy field, garden, stream, etc.), ownership details, and area measurements. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisitions and property matters.
